products.name: Migrating Cisco VPN Client Deployment from SCCM/GPO to Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Migrate Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) deployment from SCCM/GPO to Intune — re-home the client, VPN profile, and certs, coexist during cutover, and retire the legacy path — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Retire SCCM and GPO from your Cisco VPN client deployment

Many fleets still push the Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) and its VPN profile through SCCM packages and Group Policy — on-prem plumbing that breaks for remote and cloud-managed devices. This solution migrates that deployment to Microsoft Intune cleanly: re-home the client install, the VPN profile, and any certificate delivery to Intune, run both side by side during cutover, and retire the SCCM/GPO path — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the migration model (inventory the current SCCM/GPO deployment, rebuild it in Intune, coexist during cutover, retire the legacy path) and how to avoid double-deployment conflicts.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune enrollment, the Secure Client installers + VPN profile/XML, the current SCCM/GPO deployment details, certificate delivery, Entra groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to rebuild the client + VPN profile in Intune, handle coexistence with the SCCM/GPO deployment, migrate a named pilot, validate parity, cut over waves, and remove the legacy delivery.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — current-state discovery (SCCM/GPO VPN deployment), per-device migration validation, a migration-progress/coexistence report, safe remediation/cleanup of legacy artifacts, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates (Intune-delivered client + profile working, legacy path removed, no conflict), plus Best Practices for wave-based cutover.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The Cisco VPN client and profile delivered from Intune instead of SCCM/GPO — migrated wave by wave, validated for parity, and proven on a pilot before you retire the legacy path.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CVPNMIG-Discovery.ps1 — current-state discovery of the Cisco VPN client, profile, and cert delivery
    • CVPNMIG-Remediation.ps1 — safely clean up legacy Cisco VPN artifacts / fix double-deployment conflicts
    • CVPNMIG-Report.ps1 — fleet migration-progress / coexistence report (legacy vs Intune-managed)
    • CVPNMIG-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the Cisco VPN migration-wave Entra group(s)
    • CVPNMIG-Validation.ps1 — confirm the Intune-delivered Cisco client, profile, and cert work on THIS device

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
